pcs.pc_description: obtain the work permit from concerned department/authority
check if oil and gas pipeline equipment are meeting safety and technical standards
monitor health of rotating and static equipment in pipeline system to identify any defect or damage
check the alignment of bearings, couplings, etc. before solo run using analytical and precision tools
perform solo run of the machine/equipment and check for any abnormalities, defect or damage
record data and compare with standard data for rated output to identify the damage/defect
examine the identified defect/damage in equipment/machine

modules.module_title: Carry out repair and preventive maintenance

pcs.pc_description: isolate the damaged part/equipment from coupling
select the appropriate tools for dismantling the damaged machines/ equipment
dismantle the damaged equipment as per the steps in maintenance manual
check internal parts such as seals, gaskets, oil rings, etc.
remove worn out, defective parts in the machine/mechanical equipment
read engineering drawings specific to machine/equipment
install new and replacement equipment as required
reassemble parts as per the equipment maintenance manual
adjust the repaired machine to its original condition as per the specifications
check reassembled equipment/machine for proper fitting, any abnormal vibration and overheating
perform solo run of the machine/equipment for any abnormalities on repaired/replaced items
monitor activity in and around pipeline and operation facilities and respond when necessary

modules.module_title: Testing of equipment & machines after repair

pcs.pc_description: perform 5S activities post repair and maintenance
couple the machine/component/equipment with the main line and do trial run
perform pressure/force testing of repaired equipment/machine as per manufacturers manual
prepare the repair and maintenance report and submit it to the supervisor
